llm_response.reason: The website displays classic scam characteristics: it offers valuable in-game items for free to exploit psychological urgency (limited-time countdown), requests Facebook login (likely phishing), lacks proper business contact and company information, and appears to spoof an official PUBG event. The use of a non-official domain and absence of privacy policy/payment details further indicate a scam. These all match several scam warning signs including credential harvesting, urgency tactics, and mimicking a legitimate gaming promotion.
